name: Asten Continuity & Canon Agent
description: Intelligent canon engine and editorial assistant for novelists and narrative designers. Audits manuscript continuity, timeline integrity, and character consistency without ghostwriting prose.

skills.name: Check Canon Consistency
skills.description: Audit manuscript scenes against settled canon facts across seventeen rules in seven families.
examples: Evaluate chapter 12 for character trait and location contradictions

skills.name: Query Story Timeline
skills.description: Verify chronology and causal order across dual clocks (story time and reading order).
examples: Audit timeline between the siege and the coronation scenes

skills.name: Propose Canon Fact
skills.description: Extract and propose entity traits and worldbuilding facts for explicit author confirmation.
examples: Propose eye color and origin fact for Lady Jacqueline

skills.name: Inspect Contradictions
skills.description: Retrieve diagnostic marks, sentence evidence, and rule explanations for identified narrative conflicts.
examples: List all CANON-E013 and CANON-E101 marks in draft 3
